assumptions.assumption: 'Total number of transactions recorded for it' means all transactions on the invoice (including any 'Payment' ones), counted for invoices that have at least one transaction whose type is not exactly 'Payment'.
Ties in count at the top-10 boundary are broken arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-break rule.
transaction_type is NOT NULL in the schema, so <> 'Payment' (case-sensitive exact match) captures all non-Payment rows.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the non-'Payment' transactions per invoice, rather than all transactions on the invoice.
